en: A typical fluffy cumulus cloud weighs over a million pounds due to its millions of suspended water droplets.
A single healthy acre of agricultural soil can contain more than one million earthworms.
Pumice is a volcanic rock filled with trapped gas bubbles that makes it light enough to float on water.
A single large oak tree can transpire and release over 100 gallons of water vapor into the air daily.
Saturn has an average density lower than water, meaning it would actually float in a giant bathtub.
A single teaspoon of material from a dense neutron star would weigh about six billion tons on Earth.
The Moon is slowly drifting away from Earth at a measurable rate of about 3.8 centimeters per year.
The 1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo cooled global temperatures by injecting millions of tons of sulfur dioxide into the stratosphere.
Certain weather stations in the Atacama Desert have recorded absolutely no rainfall for over 400 consecutive years.
Obsidian is a naturally occurring volcanic glass so incredibly sharp that it was historically used for surgical scalpels.
Olympus Mons on Mars is a massive shield volcano nearly three times taller than Earth's Mount Everest.
The Amazon River discharges so much freshwater into the Atlantic Ocean that it dilutes the seawater for hundreds of miles.
